Upgrades pause your ride and apply immediately. Coins and ranks stay in this browser .
Pick a trail and ride toward the Baron.

Spiked rails through the cactus frontier.
Neon skies above the moonlit mesas.

Latest 20 rides, saved only in this browser .
Start a ride to save your first run.
